bugs.title: Vertical ad creative is cropped instead of displayed with FIT
bugs.symptom: The 9:16 ad now fits without the prior crop, but the fitted video box is anchored to the far left instead of horizontally centered in the full-screen sponsored viewer.
working_comparisons: Expected full vertical frame centered with equal black side space
bugs.root_cause: The physical FIT sizing repair corrected the source ratio, but centering still depended on inherited flex/grid positioning and remained vulnerable to a left anchor.
bugs.fix_summary: New repair candidate deployed: fitguard3 explicitly positions the fitted ad video at left:50% and top:50% with translate(-50%,-50%), while preserving the physical source-ratio dimensions. This removes inherited layout as the owner of ad centering.
bugs.future_repair: Verify the live 9:16 creative is physically fitted and centered. Black pillarbox space should be balanced on both sides with no crop.

bugs.title: Ads CMS break cadence is ignored and ads play every other song
bugs.symptom: The Ads CMS is set to run an ad after every song/video, but DEV V2 still inserts commercials every other song/video.
affected_examples: DEV V2 desktop live sequence on 2026-08-21
working_comparisons: CMS controller displays After every song/video
Expected Song -> Ad -> Song -> Ad sequence
bugs.root_cause: The every-song break claimant was loaded at the end of the clean desktop script stack. Earlier transition handlers could own or terminate the natural-ended path before the cadence claimant ran, leaving a CMS-owed break pending until a later track transition.
bugs.fix_summary: New repair candidate deployed: cadenceguard3 now loads immediately after the shared Ads runtime and before desktop transition/queue handlers. The runtime still reads break_interval from the authoritative Ads CMS API, and interval 1 is claimed at the same natural song boundary before later player handlers advance the queue.
bugs.future_repair: Verify three consecutive natural completions while the CMS API reports break_interval 1. Each completion must produce an ad before the next song becomes audible.
